title: All images from previous hits are downloaded and take all available thread
body:
When typing a long query on a low bandwidth it becomes very slow because the browser wants to finish the download of every images that have been called by the previous queries.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/976175/10616793/50e1f08a-7767-11e5-9b7b-1ff68885f059.png)
